rationale: This Dutch administrative decision concerns a Wabo environmental revision permit (revisievergunning) for Lelystad Airport regarding the environmental effects of ground-based airport operations, the Luchthavenbesluit Lelystad, and a separate nature permit (natuurvergunning). It does not involve water law, water governance, or water/sanitation services.
